release_notes.zh-TW: 改善自動更新流程：每次啟動自動檢查更新；發現新版本時在檢查更新按鈕顯示 NEW 徽章並改為下載並更新；下載完成後以更新引導關閉程式、套用更新並自動重新啟動。版本更新至 2026.08.29。
release_notes.en: Improve the automatic update flow: check for updates on every startup; show a NEW badge and change the update button to Download and Update when a newer version is available; after downloading, guide the user through closing the app, applying the update, and automatically relaunching. Update version to 2026.08.29.
